title: Salmon and edamame rice bowl
summary: Salmon and edamame rice bowl is a japanese dinner built around salmon fillets and frozen edamame beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat salmon fillets dry and season it. Prep frozen edamame beans and basmati rice for Salmon and edamame rice bowl so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook salmon fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook frozen edamame beans and basmati rice in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Salmon and edamame rice bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice salmon fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
